description: matrix::opaque_fn_value_join::build (an AOT/native build fixture) fails intermittently ONLY in the full parallel `cargo test --test fixture_matrix` run, never in isolation. Measured at the fz-xhk green floor (commit 56dca5970, BEFORE any change): full-matrix run1 ok, run2 FAILED, run3 FAILED (2/3 fail); the same fixture passes 3/3 when run alone. So the flake is in the parallel build harness (concurrent AOT compile/link of native fixtures racing on a shared output/temp path), not in the transport plan -- the plan for this fixture is deterministic and the transport_contract_test for it is green. This is the source of the matrix oracle's 31-vs-32 instability. Fix: isolate each AOT build fixture's output dir / serialize the link step. Pre-existing; surfaced during fz-bfh.5.5 verification.
title: [BUG] opaque_fn_value_join::build flakes in the parallel fixture_matrix run
